name: pet-kart
description: 桌宠赛车：可导入桌宠 2D/3D 形象的 3D 卡丁车单文件 HTML 游戏，支持局域网和互联网中转最多 4 人

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:rules && npm run test:artifact && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:remote-motion && npm run test:remote-motion:3d && npm run test:host && npm run test:catalog
scripts.test:internet: npm run test:artifact && npm run test:relay && npm run test:mixed && npm run test:remote-motion:relay
scripts.test:delivery: npm test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:internet
scripts.test:internet:full: npm run test:internet && npm run test:physical
